steps.instruction: Keep the pen and puck well away from the tablet (nothing should be sent).
Put the 16-button PUCK on the tablet center; don't press any button. (If it's asleep, wake it with one button press BEFORE pressing Enter.)
Slide the PUCK slowly around the tablet without pressing buttons.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '0'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '1'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '2'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '3'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '4'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '5'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '6'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '7'; hold it, release, press it again.
Hold the PUCK still and press button '8'; hold it, release, press it again.
